## Site

- Name: quukk
- URL: https://www.quukk.com/
- 中文说明: quukk 围绕工具、知识、流程和模型基础设施，服务于由人与 agent 混编的智能组织。
- English description: quukk builds tools, knowledge, workflow and model infrastructure for organizations where people and agents work together.

- Glossary (en): https://www.quukk.com/en/glossary.html
